observations: Starts with the lesson heading and the entire first stem. Ends after question 6 option D; no stem or option is cut across the split.
Question 1 has five empty square checkboxes A-E. Questions 2-6 have four empty radio controls A-D each, consistently positioned before the associated option content.
Figure 218 is integrated between the first stem and its choices. Its complete displayed extent and all eight labels are visible, readable and separated from prose and controls.

All three-column, coordinate, set-operation, direction-count and relation-property tables are present with their headers and all expected rows. Tables are borderless and compact, but rows and columns remain distinguishable without overlapping or cut text.

Ray brackets, direction arrows, interval endpoints, infinity, union/intersection, sets, relation symbols and circled row markers are visibly rendered. Ideographic separators in the first options are visible; no missing-glyph box or error text is observed.
No duplicate exercise numbering, leaked correctness indicators, missing content, orphaned option text or incoherent overlap is visible.
Begins with question 7's complete coordinate/symmetry stem. All four construction tables include the center, both image-point columns, final location column and three data rows.
Question 7 has four empty radio controls A-D. Questions 8 and 9 each have five empty square checkboxes A-E.
Primes, subscripts, coordinate signs, equality statements, degree symbols and finite-set expressions are readable and intact.
Wrapped option continuations stay aligned with their own content; no control collides with a table or line of text.
The ninth stem and all five final options are complete, followed by the closing separator and blank bottom margin. No leaked keys, duplicated numbering, missing content or clipping is visible.
All four stems and option groups are encountered; prose and question 1's five options wrap without loss. Controls remain in a stable left gutter beside A-E or A-D labels.
The three-column count tables and construction stem/option tables show their complete headers and rows. Narrow headers wrap vertically but remain attached to the right columns.

Figure 218 shows its left portion, including A, C, P and F; the right portion is outside the displayed scroll window. This is the declared fixed-width scroll-media integration, not a new figure-detail failure.

Question 4's A-D tables are visibly truncated at the right edge of the option-content region: the fourth column, U intersection V, is not visible, and the first-row union interval in every option is cut before its end. Additional long union expressions in A-C are also cut.

Question 4 has all four radio controls and labels, but not four complete readable option tables. No table-scroll declaration or reached-end evidence is present in the supplied manifest; the figure scroll evidence does not establish table accessibility.
The part ends below question 4 option D. The next part starts at question 5, so the vertical split cannot supply the missing right-hand columns.
Ideographic separators remain visible in question 1; no visible KaTeX error text or missing-glyph boxes are observed. This does not override the actual interval/table clipping finding.
Questions 5-7 each show four radio controls A-D; questions 8-9 each show five square checkboxes A-E. All 22 option bodies are complete.

Direction-count tables include all three circled rows and finite sets, including the longest six-value entry. Relation-property tables include all four columns. Center-construction tables include all three rows and both image coordinates.
Column headers wrap at the narrow width, including center and image-ray location headers, without colliding with controls or losing their final words.
Symmetry stems retain primes, subscripts, negative coordinates and equality clauses. Final prose options and their mathematical expressions wrap within the content width.
No duplicate numbering, leaked keys, orphaned continuation, incoherent overlap or inaccessible clipping is visible in this part. The entire final option E and the bottom separator are present.
